global_rules.binary_rule: 1 = direct indication; 0 = explicit denial OR absence under the coding rule; 0 is not a medical conclusion
global_rules.cag: Y performed; R documented refusal; N no evidence of performed CAG; vessel codes only when ca_fact=Y
global_rules.xray_rg_pc: Preserve both positive and explicit negative congestion/pulmonary edema wording; missing only when no relevant X-ray finding is documented.
global_rules.medications: Prefer explicit discharge/continued-therapy prescriptions over inpatient treatment narrative.
global_rules.evidence: Direct non-missing values require exact source evidence; absence-coded 0/N and ordinary missing may have empty evidence.

ecg_avb.rule: Any explicitly documented AV block => 1; explicit denial or no mention in ECG => 0. Degree is metadata only.

ecg_elevation.rule: ST elevation in ECG record => 1; explicit denial or no mention => 0. Diagnosis alone cannot populate ECG field.

type_acs.rule: STEMI direct diagnosis with ST elevation; NSTEMI direct diagnosis without ST elevation; unstable angina or generic ACS with no STEMI/NSTEMI type => NA; no ACS/MI mention => не указано.

mi_localisation.rule: A anterior, I inferior, L lateral, N MI is stated but location not specified; do not infer from ECG leads.

ca_fact.rule: Y performed; R documented refusal; N otherwise when there is no performed angiography evidence.

ca_lad.rule: Only when ca_fact=Y; 0 <50%, 1 50-89%, 2 >=90% or occlusion; use maximum documented lesion for LAD.

rca.rule: Only when ca_fact=Y; 0 <50%, 1 50-89%, 2 >=90% or occlusion; use maximum documented lesion for RCA.
